summary_1line: Yudhishthira asks about managing loyal nobles; Bhishma explains that unity between king and aristocracy, avoiding greed and wrath, preserves the kingdom while disunion destroys it.

image_candidates.scene_text: An aged Bhishma lies on his bed of arrows while Yudhishthira stands beside him listening to counsel on kings and nobles.
A council of stern nobles gathered around a king, whispering in factions as tension and distrust divide the court.
